risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantified operating detail, including sales, margins, regional performance, foreign exchange effects, and supply-chain impacts. Risk tone is moderately negative due to inflation, component shortages, geopolitical conflict, COVID-19 disruptions, weaker demand, and currency volatility, although management expresses confidence in long-term growth. The forward-looking-risk disclaimer is extensive and largely boilerplate, limiting specificity regarding the magnitude and timing of future effects.
